title: sound rader
description: A Fortnite-style sound radar HUD that shows nearby players, mobs, attacks and projectiles as icons on your screen. Fully configurable via Mod Menu — adjust detection range, icon size, colors and toggle each event type on or off.
body:
A customizable audio radar system that detects surrounding sounds and visually represents their direction. Instead of displaying a visible circle, the system uses an invisible circular layout to position indicators around the user.

Sounds are shown as colored dots that appear at different positions along this invisible circle, depending on where the sound is coming from. For example, if a sound occurs behind the user, the dot appears at the bottom of the circle; sounds in front appear at the top, and so on.

Users can fully customize the system:

Choose different colors for different types of sounds

Enable or disable specific sound categories (such as vehicles, people, or footsteps)

Adjust the sensitivity and size of the detection radius (the “circle”)

Toggle which visual elements are displayed

This creates an intuitive, minimal, and non-intrusive way to understand the direction of nearby sounds without cluttering the screen.
